title: Special Topics in Italian Literature; Italian Black Writers in Translation
description: The landscape of contemporary Italian literature has been reshaped and reconfigured by the emergence of new voices and new authors who are redefining what it means to be Italian today. This course explores recent novels, autobiographical counts, short stories, comics, articles, and multimedia materials through which authors such as Gabriella Kuruvilla, Ingy Mubiayi, Igiaba Scego, Nadeesha Uyangoda, Esperance Hakuzwimana Ripanti, and others, reflect on themes of identity, post-colonialism, inclusivity, Black Italy as well as on "the right to imagination" for new generations of Italians. Taught in English. This course has a Colloquium in Italian.
